title: Finding
description: A single structured result produced by one deterministic check. Never produced by the model reading raw scan input directly.

id.description: Deterministic id derived from check + evidence, stable across re-runs on unchanged input.

check.description: Name of the check that produced this finding, e.g. 'secrets_check'.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what was found.

evidence.description: File path, line number, matched pattern, or other locator.
